title: Palace of culture - Warsaw
description: A conceptual urban study of Warsaw's Palace of Culture and Science seen through demolition, reflection, signage, weather, and skyline. The landmark keeps reappearing as a clock, a monument, a fragment, and a measure of the city's changing horizon.
